style.backgroundSystem: one surface family per shot: seamless matte mineral off-white wall and floor #F0EDE8 for the flat product screens; a charcoal grid-tile wall #262A2C with 1px off-white #F0EDE8 grout lines for the dark-loaded screens; a warm limestone plinth #E3DAD0 with one soft botanical leaf shadow for the closing still-life. Never a plain white sweep, never a colour gradient, never duplicated wall pattern
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin circle-outline icons, #262A2C stroke on light fields and #F0EDE8 stroke on charcoal fields, no fills, no gradient, no 3D badges, identical stroke weight across the set
style.lightingSystem: soft directional daylight from camera right at 5000-5500K with a cool bounce fill on the shadow side, raking light grazing the tube frame and tray grain so both read, honest soft contact shadows under the base runners only, no rim tricks, no glow halos
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium mineral-toned home-storage visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte mineral off-white #F0EDE8, deep charcoal text #262A2C, warm limestone grey #CFC9C1 and one moss accent #4E6151 (or {accent_color} when a brand hue is supplied); neutral 5000-5500K daylight from camera right with a cool bounce fill, raking light on tube and timber grain, soft believable contact shadows only; one modern geometric sans-serif family for every rendered Chinese and Latin label, headline 30-44pt and label 12-14pt, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept under 50 characters per screen; background system of seamless #F0EDE8, a charcoal grid-tile wall #262A2C with 1px #F0EDE8 grout, or a warm limestone plinth #E3DAD0 with one botanical leaf shadow, one surface family per shot; layout system of top-left headline blocks, thin 1px rules, hairline circle-outline icons, numbered feature rows and dimension leader lines; product presentation stays free-standing on a real floor with corrected verticals, true tube lean, stable scale and a real object as scale anchor; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers or certifications.
noDrift: no wall-mounted or clip-on reinterpretation of a free-standing unit
no invented wood species, board grade, alloy grade, load rating, tier count, dimension value or certification
no source brand wordmark, store badge, QR code or membership corner label
style.presentationRules: the unit is always free-standing on a real floor with corrected verticals and true lean of the side tubes; its scale is anchored by real objects (bathtub edge, stacked towels, floor tile joint, pump bottle); trays carry believable loads that never hide the product; identical tube diameter, joint form, tier count, tray construction and finish colour are held constant across the set; the product never floats and never leans without a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte micro-cement or large-format porcelain ground #D8D3CC, satin black powder-coated round tube frame, oiled walnut-look tray boards #6B4B33 with open end grain, grey limestone blocks, natural linen towels in greige #CFC9C1
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered Chinese and Latin text; headline 30-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 12-14pt; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and always supplied as placeholders, maximum 50 characters per screen
